data.exact_reserve_text: During 2017, net ultimate claims in respect of prior underwriting years (2015 & prior) reduced by GBP 10.1m. This was mainly due to favourable claims experience in Director and Officers, Marine Liability and Marine Cargo resulting in reserve releases in line with standard actuarial techniques. This was offset by net ultimate claims increases in International Construction (adverse attritional and large loss development on Starr coverholder business), Professional Indemnity (large losses reported in the year; Appleby, Shepherd Building Group, Precision and Pitcher Partners) and General Liability (adverse attritional development).

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1919 reported a modest net release of prior year claims reserves in 2017. Using the gross claims development table the aggregate prior-year movement across underwriting years up to 2015 was a release of approximately GBP 6.66m (c.1.3% of opening gross claims reserves of GBP 506.8m). The reported net movement (after reinsurance) was a reduction of GBP 10.1m mainly driven by favourable claims experience in Director & Officers, Marine Liability and Marine Cargo, partially offset by adverse development in International Construction, Professional Indemnity (several large reported losses) and General Liability.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 39) since the reconciliation note shows overall gross opening and closing balances but does not explicitly state a gross 'prior year development' figure. The report text quotes a net prior year reduction of GBP 10.1m (after reinsurance) - the gross triangle indicates a net gross release of c.GBP 6.661m. FX movements and other items (e.g. small reported 'movement in provision' and foreign exchange differences) affect the headline gross movement; no explicit single-line gross PYD figure was provided. Confidence levels reflect calculated (0.8) and explicit (1.0) sources as annotated.
